params.body:
Shane asked whether there is a screen where a dealer sets his own notification preferences ("immediately for biddings, daily bundled for ..."). There is not, and it was not written down as a wish either, so here it is as an open point.

What exists today is one switch, `mail_once_per_day`, and it is narrower than it looks: it covers only the bidding mails, and since this morning only for dealers, because a merchant no longer gets a daily mail at all. The other twenty-odd mails have no control, and the in-app notifications have none either — every user of the dealer gets every kind.

The point records that, and the three questions that decide the shape before anything is built: per user or per dealer (the two halves disagree today), which grain (per mail is a screen nobody reads; per subject means giving every mail a subject, which is the actual work), and whether "off" may exist at all for a mail like the order form.

It also notes the cheap intermediate step: the existing flag sits among the dealer's company details, is called "one mail per day", and says nowhere that it is only about biddings.

No code, no rules; `users.preferences` (R P1-1.20) is named as the place this would land.
params.title: Notification preferences as an open point
